Alex: Quick Q — we're trying to make the JS SDK prefer undici in Node for perf but fall back to global fetch in Edge runtimes. Running into two things: 1) ESM/CJS import headaches across bundlers, 2) auth headers getting lost on retries because the request body stream is consumed. Anyone seen patterns we should standardize on for SDK v2?

Sam: For the undici import, use the named export: `import { fetch as undiciFetch } from "undici";` — avoid assuming a default export. For CJS consumers: `const { fetch } = require("undici")`. Strongly recommend a tiny adapter module that normalizes a single named `fetch` export across runtimes. Also note `undici@5` has much better ESM interop.

Jen: About retries — the core problem is that streaming bodies are one-shot. If we auto-retry, the body needs to be retriable. Options: buffer small bodies (ok for JSON), or use stream tee/clone in environments that support it. Example (sync-style):
```js
// naive: buffer then reuse
const buf = await req.arrayBuffer();
function makeReq() { return new Request(url, { method: 'POST', body: buf, headers }); }
// on retry call makeReq() again
```
This works but is heavy for large uploads.

Patrick: Practical SDK policy suggestion: only do automatic retries for safe/idempotent requests (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS). For POSTs with bodies, either don't retry automatically or only retry when body size < X and we've buffered. Keeps semantics predictable.

Sam: Also typing-wise, we should export a common Fetch type so downstream TS users don't face `lib.dom` vs node typings mismatch. Something like:
```ts
export type FetchFn = (input: RequestInfo, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>
```
And accept `fetch?: FetchFn` in the client constructor.

Alex: Good call. The adapter approach means the SDK code just calls `this.fetch(...)` and tests can stub easily. I'd prefer to ship a tiny package in the monorepo `@redwood/fetch-adapter` that resolves `globalThis.fetch || undici.fetch || polyfill` at import time.

Jen: Edge runtimes (Cloudflare/Workers, Deno) have slightly different ReadableStream implementations — avoid Node stream-specific helpers in code paths that run in Edge. For retries, prefer ArrayBuffer buffering or bail out to consumer.

CI-bot: build/canary failed on undici import in our ESM test matrix — PR #412 flagged, rolling back commit to stabilize CI. :eyes:

Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll draft a short RFC: adapter package + default retry policy (auto-retry only for idempotent methods; opt-in buffered retries for small bodies). @Patrick can you capture test matrix for idempotency rules (node undici, node global fetch, cloudflare, deno)? :thumbsup:
